This camera has no usable flash.
Fixed holds the lens still, which tracks more steadily in dim rooms. Auto focus keeps close-up surfaces sharp.
ARCore sets exposure and ISO itself, so there is no exposure slider: more light is the only lever. Turn the torch on, or move somewhere brighter, for steadier tracking.
Low light — turn the light on for steadier tracking
Nothing to measure there — aim at a surface
Point limit reached — undo or clear to continue
Measuring with AR needs the camera. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
Another app is probably using the camera. Close it and try again.
Install Google Play Services for AR
Measuring needs ARCore. Finish the install from the Play Store, then come back.
This device does not support ARCore, which this app needs to measure. Google Play Services for AR must be installed and the device must be on the supported list.
The AR session could not start. Try again, or reopen the app.
